description: NaScB₂O₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.90 Å. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing ScO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.16 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.36-1.42 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.35-1.43 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na and two B atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and one B atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sc, and one B atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sc, and one B atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one B atom.
